text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Project L'Arc gets underway. The 
participants are provided with VR 
Umulators, allowing them to train in 
overseas environments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, a "Representative Exchange 
Match" is scheduled—a VR race bridging 
nations to compete against world-class 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, there was still a problem. To 
cover the project expenses, they needed to 
gather support from all across Japan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking on SS Matches and Representative 
Matches, the journey toward the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe begins amidst the 
growing hopes of countless fans.
